title: Senior Software Engineer, Operations Foundations
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Wolt is looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Front-end-leaning) to join our Operations Foundations team. The team sits within the DoorDash Client and AI Development group and is responsible for the foundation that hundreds of engineers across Wolt, DoorDash, and Deliveroo rely on to build internal operations tools. Our platform hosts 250+ micro-frontends (MFEs) used to operate every part of the business.

Our team is focused on building a scalable, reliable, and high-quality internal tooling platform that supports Wolt, DoorDash, and Deliveroo's operations and business.

The team plays an important role in improving how engineers build, test, and ship software across the organization, with a strong emphasis on reusable libraries, micro-frontend architecture, and agentic development: building the platform where AI agents can take changes from task to merged PR safely and reliably without lowering the quality bar.

Currently, we are focused on unifying our frontend platforms, evolving shared components and library development, improving developer productivity, and enabling teams to deliver more independently through better architecture and tooling.

It's an exciting time to join because the team has strong ownership and a broad technical impact.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer who can take ownership of complex technical initiatives across both frontend and sometimes backend and infra domains. In this role, you'll work primarily with TypeScript, React, Node.js, CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Buildkite), and MFE architecture to build scalable, maintainable solutions that support multiple product teams and business areas.

Success in this role means becoming a trusted technical owner who consistently delivers reliable solutions and helps the team execute more effectively. Six months into the role, we'd expect you to be independently leading technical initiatives and contributing meaningfully to architecture and delivery planning.

This role offers the opportunity to solve challenging engineering problems with visible impact across the business. It's especially exciting for someone who enjoys combining product engineering with platform thinking, improving developer workflows, and building systems that scale across teams and domains.

What you'll be doing

  • Owning the Foundation: the runtime, build, deployment, and developer experience that 250+ MFEs and hundreds of engineers depend on every day.
  • Evolving Our Micro-Frontend Architecture: improve composition, isolation, and shared dependency strategies so feature teams can move fast.
  • Product and Planning: Independently drive projects from idea to production: breaking down ambiguous problems into clear technical plans, estimating delivery, identifying risks early, and delivering high-quality solutions in a timely manner.
  • Supporting Engineering Excellence: Champion best practices, raise the bar for code quality, and turn lessons learned into platform improvements.
  • Long-Term Thinking: Balance short-term feature unblockers with the long-term health, security, and maintainability of the platform.
  • Agentic Development: Build the foundations that let AI agents work autonomously on our platform, including agent instructions, reusable skills, tool integrations, guardrails, and the automated checks that make agent-authored changes safe to ship.
  • AI Fluency: Work agent-first in your own day-to-day: delegate implementation to agents, and focus your judgment on direction, architecture, and verifying outcomes.

📍This role can be based in our Berlin tech hub. Read more about our hybrid setup here.

Feel free to check out the Wolt Tech Blog for more insight into our culture and technology.

Our humble expectations

  • Proven expertise in building production frontend applications using TypeScript and React.
  • Solid backend knowledge, comfortable owning and operating Node.js services that support frontend infrastructure.
  • Strong knowledge of frontend build tools, bundlers, and module systems, and the ability to evolve them as the platform grows.
  • Track record of diagnosing and resolving complex performance, reliability, or DX issues in large frontend codebases.
  • Experience driving technical initiatives across multiple engineering teams and stakeholders.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills: aligning priorities, managing expectations, and communicating trade-offs clearly with partner teams and leadership.
  • Strong communication skills and a collaborative, platform-mindset approach to working with feature teams.
  • Strong documentation skills, including experience writing RFCs or ADRs.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with micro-frontend architecture.
  • Frontend platform engineering experience.
  • Experience building shared component libraries used by many product teams.
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, deployment processes, and cloud infrastructure for frontend workloads.
  • Experience or interest in observability and reliability (SRE).
  • Experience building tooling or workflows for autonomous AI coding agents (e.g., agent instructions, skills, MCP servers, or evaluating agent-generated code).

What's in it for you

  • Impact: Build and shape the platform that thousands of people depend on.
  • Scale: Work on real platform problems behind 250+ MFEs with hundreds of monthly contributors.
  • Collaboration: Partner with talented engineers, designers, and operators across companies to make their daily work faster and better.
  • Growth: Take on deep technical challenges across frontend architecture, agentic development, DX, and improving engineering efficiency.
  • Culture: Be part of a diverse, open-minded team that values creativity, autonomy, and continuous learning.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

title: Lead Energy Services (m/w/d)
description:

Unser Ziel ist es, die dezentrale Energiewende einfach und zugänglich zu machen. 🌞

Als wachsendes Start-up in Berlin setzen wir auf Teamarbeit, Verantwortung und Mitgestaltung. Jede:r hat die Möglichkeit, aktiv zur Weiterentwicklung beizutragen und Ideen einzubringen. Gemeinsam arbeiten wir an einer nachhaltigen Zukunft. 🚀

Über die Rolle

Wenn bei uns eine PV-Anlage fertig gebaut ist, fängt ein Großteil unserer Wertschöpfung erst an: Über Mieterstrom, GGV und Onsite PPA versorgen wir ganze Häuser mit grünem Strom direkt vom eigenen Dach, Tag für Tag und Jahr für Jahr. Energy Services ist der Bereich, in dem aus Contracted ARR echter ARR wird – in der Strombelieferung, im Betrieb und in der Abrechnung. Der Bereich ist schnell gewachsen, und das Team hat mit Automatisierungen und einer zentralen Energiedatenbank starke Grundlagen gelegt. Jetzt suchen wir die Person, die Energy Services als Ganzes führt: Du berichtest direkt an unseren CEO und führst ein Team aus vier Personen.

Unser Prinzip dabei: Routinearbeit gehört in Automatisierungen – die Zeit unserer Leute gehört Urteilsvermögen, Kundenbeziehungen und Entscheidungen.

Deine Aufgaben

Steuerung, Wachstum & Führung

  • Du verantwortest Contracted ARR und ARR von Energy Services und sorgst dafür, dass neue Projekte schnell live gehen und Umsatz bringen

  • Du entwickelst das KPI-Framework für Energy Services und baust eine klare, für das ganze Team sichtbare Kette von den Zielen bis zu den Ergebnissen auf

  • Du führst und entwickelst dein Team und gibst jeder Person klare Ziele, KPIs und Raum zum Gestalten

  • Du entwickelst unsere Strategie für Mieterstrom im Bestand, etwa mit Blick auf die Kosten pro Gebäude, und steuerst die Akquise vor Ort

Prozesse, Systeme & Regulatorik

  • Du bringst die Abrechnung von der Liegenschaft bis zum Zahlungseingang auf ein neues Level: Du definierst den Prozess, standardisierst ihn und automatisierst ihn konsequent

  • Du übernimmst unsere Schnittstelle zum Energiemanagementsystem (EMS) und entwickelst sie weiter

  • Du machst EEG-Vergütung, Mieterstromzuschlag, Direktvermarktung, Marktstammdatenregister und Messstellenbetrieb zu sauberen, verlässlichen Prozessen

  • Du arbeitest eng mit Asset Management, Finance, Project Management und Sales zusammen und lieferst die Datenbasis für unser Reporting an Banken und Kund*innen

Gewünschte Qualifikationen

Das bringst du mit:

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium, z. B. in Energiewirtschaft, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder BWL, oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Du konntest bereits mehrjährige Erfahrung (3+ Jahre) in der Energiewirtschaft sammeln, idealerweise in Mieterstrom, GGV, Energievertrieb oder Messwesen

  • Du hast bereits ein Team geführt und Verantwortung für Umsatzziele getragen

  • Du verfügst über ein gutes Verständnis des regulatorischen Rahmens (EEG, EnWG, MsbG) und der Marktkommunikation (z. B. MaLo, MeLo, Messstellenbetreiber)

  • Du gehst sicher mit KPIs und Dashboards um und triffst Entscheidungen datenbasiert

  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und gutes Englisch

  • Erfahrung mit Abrechnungs- und Energiemanagementsystemen (EMS) sowie mit Tools wie Salesforce, Airtable oder Make ist von Vorteil

  • Erfahrung in einem Start-up oder Scale-up ist wünschenswert, aber kein Muss

Zusätzlich zählen für uns folgende Kompetenzen:

  • Datenbasierte Entscheidungsfindung – Du steuerst über Kennzahlen statt über Bauchgefühl und fragst bei jedem KPI, welche Entscheidung er ermöglicht

  • Prozess- und Automatisierungskompetenz – Du schaust auf einen gewachsenen Abrechnungsprozess und erkennst, was bleibt, was du neu baust und was eine Automatisierung übernimmt

  • Führungskompetenz – In deinem Team weiß jede Person, was ihr Ziel ist und wie sie zum ARR beiträgt

  • Tech-Affinität: Du siehst neue Tools und KI als Hebel, nicht als Bedrohung

  • Unternehmerisches Denken – Du triffst Entscheidungen immer im Kontext von Wachstum, Marge und Strategie

Das erwartet dich bei uns

Mit deinen Ideen gestaltest du die Zukunft der Solarenergie in einem schnell wachsenden Start-up aktiv mit!

  • Eine Schlüsselrolle mit direktem Draht zum CEO und 100 % Verantwortung für deinen Bereich

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern und eine steile Lernkurve

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Home Office für eine gute Work-Life-Balance

  • Modernes Office im Zentrum Berlins mit sehr guter BVG-Anbindung (z. B. Nordbahnhof, Rosenthaler Platz)

  • Voll ausgestattete Küche mit Kaffee, Softdrinks und Snacks rund um die Uhr

title: Senior Google Ads Specialist | International Ecommerce | Berlin ASAP
description:
ennovationHUB is an expanding international e-commerce group specialising in the home & living sector, with furniture at the core of our offering. Through our hubs in Belgrade, Barcelona, and London, we serve customers throughout the UK, North America, the EU, and APAC.

As we work towards €160m+ in annual revenue by 2027, we are seeking a Senior Google Ads Specialist to join us as soon as possible. You will lead Google Ads performance for one of our portfolio brands, taking direct responsibility for revenue growth, advertising efficiency, and profitability.

About the opportunity:

You will be part of an international business operating multiple e-commerce brands, with substantial advertising investment across several markets. Working at this scale means your decisions will directly influence revenue and commercial results.

Google Ads already plays a significant role in our growth. We are looking for someone who enjoys navigating international e-commerce, working with large datasets, and uncovering opportunities that deliver measurable improvements.

Working alongside our Head of Performance Marketing, creative team, and data specialists, you will use analysis, experimentation, and hands-on optimisation to develop this established channel further. Your focus will be on maintaining strong current performance while supporting efficient growth over time.

What you will be responsible for:

  • Own Google Ads performance across international markets for one of our e-commerce brands

  • Run and optimise Search, Shopping, Performance Max, and other relevant campaign formats

  • Monitor and improve core performance measures, including ROAS, CPA, conversion rate, revenue, and profitability

  • Drive growth and improve advertising efficiency across your assigned portfolio

  • Uncover opportunities within product ranges, categories, markets, and audience groups

  • Turn campaign insights into clear recommendations and practical next steps

  • Conduct account reviews and introduce continuous performance improvements

  • Work with developers and analytics colleagues to maintain accurate tracking and reliable measurement

  • Collaborate with creative and content teams to strengthen advertising effectiveness and landing page results

  • Contribute to budget allocation, forecasting, and performance reporting

  • Stay informed about platform updates, AI-powered advertising capabilities, and industry best practices

  • Help develop structured tests and experiments that strengthen account performance over time

The impact you can make:

Our Google Ads campaigns already generate results. You will build on that foundation by uncovering further opportunities, improving efficiency, and scaling successful approaches.

In a competitive e-commerce environment, even small improvements can make a significant commercial difference. You will connect campaign decisions to business outcomes and remain accountable for their impact.

You will collaborate with experienced colleagues who work quickly and place a high value on execution. We welcome independent judgment, evidence-based decisions, and constructive questions about existing approaches. You will have the trust to make decisions and directly support the company’s growth.



In-house e-commerce experience is a requirement for this position. Candidates whose Google Ads experience is primarily gained through agencies, consultancy, or freelance work will not be considered.

We are looking for someone who has owned performance within an e-commerce company, with results evaluated through revenue, profitability, customer acquisition, and sustained growth.

You should understand how campaign performance connects to wider commercial goals and be comfortable taking responsibility for both decision-making and implementation.

What you will bring:

  • A minimum of 2 years of practical experience managing Google Ads campaigns

  • A proven record of managing Google Ads within an e-commerce business, with direct accountability for results and profitability

  • Extensive practical knowledge of Search, Shopping, and Performance Max campaigns

  • Experience working as part of an in-house e-commerce team

  • The ability to analyse large datasets and identify opportunities that can be put into practice

  • A solid grasp of attribution, tracking, and performance measurement

  • Working familiarity with Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, and Google Merchant Center

  • Strong analytical skills and a thorough approach to detail

  • Fluency in spoken and written English

  • The ability to adapt to shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment

  • A curious, proactive approach and a commitment to ongoing improvement

  • Confidence operating independently, making decisions, and owning the results

  • A readiness to use AI and automation as we continue introducing them across the business

  • Availability to start immediately or as soon as possible

Your working style:

You bring senior-level judgment while staying actively involved in campaign execution and performance. You draw clear conclusions from data and translate those findings into practical action.

You want to understand what drives results and regularly look for ways to improve them. You can move comfortably between longer-term planning and daily optimisation while keeping business growth and commercial outcomes in focus.

You enjoy developing and scaling campaigns, accepting responsibility for their performance, and helping an established channel continue to grow.

International collaboration and travel:

Our team works across London, Belgrade, Barcelona, Frankfurt, Oxfordshire, Istanbul, and Guangzhou. As the company grows, we are continuing to invest in our team presence.

The role includes travel approximately every 4–8 weeks to Belgrade, Barcelona, London, or other team locations. These visits provide time for joint planning, workshops, team gatherings, and strategic discussions.

Most work takes place remotely, complemented by regular opportunities to collaborate and plan together in person as the business scales.

This is a long-term opportunity to make a meaningful contribution to the growth of an international e-commerce group.

Our culture at ennovationHUB:

We value:

  • Taking ownership and following through on commitments

  • Turning plans into action

  • Communicating clearly and directly

  • Building knowledge through hands-on experience

We welcome people from different backgrounds who care about the quality of their work, take responsibility for their contribution, and help the business progress.

title: Marketing & Communications Manager (m/w/d)
description:
Du möchtest nicht einfach Marketing machen. Du möchtest etwas bewegen.

Du hast Freude daran, Dinge aufzubauen, Menschen zusammenzubringen und aus guten Ideen etwas Konkretes zu machen? Du bist neugierig, stellst Fragen und probierst auch mal neue Wege aus? Und Du findest, dass gute Ergebnisse am besten gemeinsam entstehen?

Dann könnten wir gut zusammenpassen.

Wir suchen keinen Menschen, der einfach nur einen Marketingplan abarbeitet. Wir suchen jemanden, der mitdenkt, Verantwortung übernimmt, Dinge hinterfragt und Lust hat, mit uns etwas zu gestalten.

Dabei glauben wir an klare Worte, gegenseitiges Vertrauen und hohe Ansprüche an unsere Arbeit. Wir nehmen unsere Aufgaben ernst – uns selbst aber nicht immer. Und wir sind überzeugt, dass Professionalität und Menschlichkeit zusammengehören.

Über OIXIO

OIXIO gehört zu den führenden IT-Anbietern Estlands – einem Land, das wie kaum ein anderes in Europa für gelebte Digitalisierung und einen hohen Stellenwert von Cybersecurity steht.

Was dort über viele Jahre gewachsen ist, bringen wir jetzt verstärkt nach Deutschland: technologische Kompetenz, pragmatische Lösungen, direkte Zusammenarbeit und die Überzeugung, dass gute Digitalisierung vor allem eines tun muss – funktionieren.

Mit OIXIO erminas verbinden wir diesen estnischen Spirit mit unserer langjährigen Erfahrung mit deutschen Hidden Champions im Mittelstand und unserer lokalen Basis in Oldenburg. Gemeinsam unterstützen wir Unternehmen dabei, ihre IT sicher, verlässlich und zukunftsfähig aufzustellen – von Cybersecurity und IT-Infrastruktur über Business-Anwendungen und Cloud bis zu Daten, KI und Industrial IoT.

In Deutschland stehen wir mit unserer gemeinsamen Geschichte noch am Anfang – und kaum jemand kennt hier bisher unseren Namen. Genau deshalb suchen wir jemanden, der das ändern will und lieber etwas aufbaut, als eine fertige Rolle zu übernehmen.

Die Aufgabe

Als Marketing & Communications Manager Deutschland machst Du OIXIO bei mittelständischen Industrieunternehmen bekannt und vertrauenswürdig – vor allem in Norddeutschland und Nordrhein-Westfalen – und schaffst die Gespräche, auf denen unser Vertrieb aufbaut.

Du entwickelst unsere Botschaften für den deutschen Markt und übersetzt unser Angebot in klare Geschichten für IT, Produktion und Geschäftsführung.

Gemeinsam mit unserem Sales Account Manager steuerst Du gezielte Kampagnen für eine definierte Liste von Zielunternehmen und machst aus Interesse konkrete Gespräche.

Du baust die Präsenz von OIXIO auf LinkedIn auf – für das Unternehmen sowie für unsere Expertinnen, Experten und Geschäftsführung.

Du pflegst Kontakte zu Fach- und Regionalmedien und platzierst Artikel, Fachbeiträge und Kundengeschichten.

Du organisierst eigene Veranstaltungen – vom Kundenfrühstück im Werk über Webinare bis zu Roundtables – und wählst die Messen und Netzwerkveranstaltungen aus, auf denen wir präsent sind.

Du erstellst Inhalte, die überzeugen: Case Studies, One-Pager, Präsentationen, Videos und Webinhalte – gemeinsam mit unseren Fachleuten in Deutschland, Estland und Litauen.

Du misst, was wirkt – Website-Besuche, Anfragen, Veranstaltungsteilnahmen, aktivierte Zielunternehmen und Vertriebstermine – und steuerst Deine Aktivitäten in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM.

Unsere Themen: Cybersecurity, Informationssicherheit, Managed IT Services, Microsoft Business Central/NAV-Modernisierung, Prozessdigitalisierung, Industrial IoT, Cloud, Daten und KI.

Was Du mitbringen solltest

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im B2B-Marketing oder in der Unternehmenskommunikation, idealerweise mit IT-Services, Managed Services, Industrieautomation, Beratung oder Business-Anwendungen.

  • Nachweisbare Erfolge darin, Sichtbarkeit aufzubauen und Nachfrage zu erzeugen – gerne auch als erste oder einzige Marketingverantwortliche in einem Unternehmen oder Markt.

  • Erfahrung mit Kampagnen für konkrete Zielunternehmen und mehrere Entscheiderinnen und Entscheider auf Kundenseite.

  • Gutes Verständnis für mittelständische Unternehmen, besonders im industriellen Umfeld, und die Fähigkeit, technische Themen verständlich zu erklären.

  • Starke Schreibkompetenz, sicherer Umgang mit LinkedIn, CRM und Web-Analytics, sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und sehr gutes Englisch.

  • Du kennst die wichtigsten Werkzeuge des modernen B2B-Marketings und weißt, wie Du ihre Wirkung misst. Ob Dynamics 365, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Analytics, SEO-Tools oder KI: Entscheidend ist für uns nicht, dass Du jedes Tool bereits beherrschst, sondern dass Du weißt, was Du erreichen willst, und Dich schnell in neue Werkzeuge einarbeiten kannst.

  • Flexibler Wohnort in Norddeutschland, sofern regelmäßige persönliche Treffen mit dem Team in unserem Büro in Oldenburg gut möglich sind; Reisebereitschaft deutschlandweit, gelegentlich auch nach Estland und Litauen.

Was gut zu uns passt

  • Du hast Freude daran, Dinge aufzubauen. Ein komplett bestelltes Feld brauchst Du nicht – im Gegenteil: Du erkennst Möglichkeiten, entwickelst Ideen und übernimmst Verantwortung dafür, daraus etwas zu machen.

  • Du bist neugierig auf Menschen, Unternehmen und Technologien und willst verstehen, bevor Du kommunizierst.

  • Du schätzt Flexibilität, möchtest aber nicht ausschließlich im Homeoffice arbeiten. Der persönliche Austausch im Team, mit unseren Kunden und mit der Presse ist Dir wichtig.

  • Du kannst die Stärke und Erfahrung einer etablierten internationalen IT-Gruppe nutzen und gleichzeitig mit uns herausfinden, was davon für den deutschen Mittelstand wirklich relevant ist.

  • Du arbeitest eigenständig, aber nicht als Einzelkämpfer. Bei uns ist Marketing Teamsport: Gute Ergebnisse entstehen gemeinsam mit Vertrieb, Consultants, Technik und Geschäftsführung.

  • Du misst Deinen Erfolg at Gesprächen und Kunden – nicht an Likes – und versprichst nichts, was unser Team nicht halten kann.

description:
tl;dr

  • After 14 years in construction tech, Lea & Jonas are building the AI foundation for the construction industry

  • 6 of Europe's 20 largest construction companies already rely on Kuro, with leading construction enterprises representing over €40bn in combined annual construction volume using the platform every day

  • Construction has some of the most complex, unstructured data you can throw at an LLM. At Kuro, you can tackle some of the hardest problems in applied AI every day

  • Curious about the bigger engineering challenge? Explore the vision and open problems at kuro.build.

About us

Lea and Jonas scaled two of Europe's leading construction tech companies - Capmo and alcemy - and saw firsthand the challenges holding the industry back. Now they're tackling the root cause: the 50% of construction work still lost to manual data handling.

Kuro is building the AI foundation for construction. We're reimagining how construction professionals get work done and make decisions by leveraging AI to augment back-office workflows and make core data accessible. We are not pursuing marginal improvements, but a step change for construction.

After one year on the market, leading construction enterprises with a combined annual construction volume of >€40 billion use Kuro every day to automate workflows and make faster, better decisions. Backed by an €10 million seed round, we already process more than 1 million pages every month and expect that volume to grow 10x over the next six months.

We are 15 people based in Berlin. You will join a group of technical ex-founders and builders who are ambitious and kind.

Learn more: Join Kuro - Berlin

What You'll Do

Set the technical direction

  • Own the architecture decisions for the platform, from document ingestion to the chat UI

  • Write and review RFCs. The technical roadmap for the next two to three quarters is yours.

  • Make the build-or-buy decisions: which models we use, and which retrieval and orchestration stack we build on.

  • Turn a vague customer request (“show me where the bid deviates from the BoQ”) into a scoped plan with the risks named.

Raise the bar for the team

  • Mentor engineers: Review their designs and their code.

  • Define the engineering standards. Find what slows the team down, in tooling or in the CI/CD pipeline, and fix it.

  • Interview and hire engineers.

  • You have no direct reports. You change decisions in product and in other teams with a written argument.

Build and own end-to-end (AI) features

  • Design and implement new features to solve a specific user problem, such as document versioning or our agentic Chat.

  • From concept to DB schema, to optimizing LLMs, to UI. Own the full development lifecycle of customer-facing features.

  • Manage evaluations and scoring, and perform error analysis on new and shipped AI features.

Build the platform that abstracts workflow building

  • Contribute to the workflow harness, decision-trace standard, and eval tooling so a new use case ships in ~1 month

  • Build reusable human review & approval surfaces where trust in AI output is earned

Work on the construction ontology & project graph

  • Help model and evolve canonical entities of our customers

  • Contribute to entity resolution across sources: recognizing the same requirement, position, or price across BoQs, contracts, drawings, and bids

  • Build features so answers are evidence-linked and auditable, and decisions flow back into the graph

Contribute to scalable data pipelines & integrations

  • Extend our multi-modal ingestion of unstructured documents - PDFs, scans, drawings, and 3D models - orchestrated and cost-efficient at scale

  • Build read/write integrations with customer systems (document management, ERP/AVA), so workflows complete work end-to-end

Projects you would be involved in

Current & Past projects

  • Project & document versioning guaranteeing data lineage in construction projects

  • German tokenizer for construction-specific search

  • Document pipeline ingesting 10,000s of PDFs per day

  • Native BIM/DWG file support: ingesting and processing 3D models

  • Design the ontology v1 + graph schema: core construction entities, evidence links, and per-customer extension model

  • Build out our workflow harness to run agentic workflows for customers

Current Tech Stack

It is still day 0 for Kuro. Therefore, we are highly pragmatic with our tool choices. We believe in keeping it simple and moving quickly. You significantly help shape our tech stack decisions.

  • Web-App: Typescript

  • Database / Vector DB and File Storage: AWS RDS / Trubopuffer / AWS S3

  • Backend: Fastify API + Prisma ORM

  • Workflow Orchestrator: Prefect (Python)

  • Hosting: AWS Elastic Beanstalk

  • AI: Azure / OpenAI, Gemini, Cohere, AWS

  • Obsv., Eval. & Tracking: Langfuse, Datadog

Your profile

This is the perfect role for an experienced engineer who wants to join an early stage company that builds a high impact applied AI product

  • Bring 6+ years of experience as a Staff (full-stack) software engineer or Technical Lead, in a fast-paced environment

  • Have proven experience delivering production-grade applied AI features to customers

  • Take full ownership of solving customer problems by designing and implementing AI features

  • Thrive in a small, accountable team with a high degree of ownership and a drive to make an impact

  • Communicate fluently in both spoken and written English

  • Enjoy working onsite with the team at our office in Factory Berlin Mitte every day

Bonus Points

  • You’ve started a company before or worked at a very early stage startup

  • You built side projects in the past - we’re excited to hear about these!

  • German-speaking (definitely not a must, we’re fully international)

Why Kuro

You’ll join at a point when customer demand is proven, but our product and platform are still yours to shape. You’ll own customer-facing features end to end while building the foundations beneath them, from ingestion pipelines and workflow infrastructure to our construction ontology and project graph.

As Kuro grows, you can grow with it, whether as a leading individual contributor, technical leader or people manager.

 

The Process

  • Talent Acquisition Call – Intro, motivation, logistics & fit (30 min)

  • Impact Interview – Deep dive into your experience, ownership & impact (60 min)

  • On-site Day

    • System Design – Designing under ambiguity & LLM craft (45 min)

    • AI-Native Coding – Hands-on coding with AI (45 min)

    • Final Culture Interview (approx. 60 min)

  • Reference calls

  • Decision

description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

What the job actually feels like

This is a build job.

When you join, BLP has no UK pipeline, no UK case studies, and no local playbook. It’s not the well-oiled machine with sophisticated processes for everything. What you get instead: an experienced Account Executive sitting next to you, a reporting line to the VP of Business Development and a strong DACH SDR team behind you. You get a winning product and a market nobody here has sold into yet. All of that comes with strong support from the Switzerland HQ.


Your first job is to work out who buys, why, and what makes them pick up the phone. You will hear no far more often than yes. The yes is a 30-minute discovery call with a CFO, COO, or Head of Finance at a large UK manufacturer or industrial business, where you run the meeting, present the value, and map the stakeholders live.

If you want a finished machine to plug into, this is the wrong role. If you want to help build the machine, read on.

 

About the role

As our Founding SDR in London, you own outbound into UK enterprise accounts. You will prospect and open relationships with Finance and Procurement leaders (CFO, COO, Head of Shared Services, Process Excellence, AP) and generate qualified opportunities for our agentic AI platform automating Purchase-to-Pay and Order-to-Cash. Don’t expect inbounds to carry you from day one.

You are one of the first commercial hires on the ground in a new market. You prospect, you run the connect calls, and you help write the playbook the next UK hires will use. You report directly to the VP of Business Development for now, work day to day with the UK Account Executive as a tag-team, and lean on the DACH SDR team for what already works.

You will monitor the UK market with regards to procurement and finance processes, ERP transformation announcements and buying triggers, and turn what you learn into better targeting. We need you to flag what is not working early and bring it to the team, so we fix the approach fast instead of grinding on a broken one.

Once the UK team reaches critical mass and shows initial success, we hire a local team lead (internally or externally).

 

Tech stack

You will work with a sharp outbound stack: HubSpot as our CRM and source of truth, Clay for enrichment and signal-based prospecting, Claude for AI assisted tasks and research, and LinkMatch to keep LinkedIn and HubSpot in sync without manual logging. That said, the work has a strong outbound and calling focus. You will help decide what to add as the motion matures.

 

We're excited about you because

  • You have roughly 2 to 5 years of experience in a B2B SaaS SDR or BDR role, most of it outbound, and you have built or helped build an outbound motion rather than only working an established one.

  • You know the UK market and can navigate UK enterprise buyers, ideally with experience selling to Finance, Procurement, or Operations.

  • You can run a discovery call with a senior stakeholder: you hold the room, communicate clearly, adapt to a CFO or a Head of Procurement, and understand the buying center.

  • You are comfortable with ambiguity. No inbound, no case studies, no script on day one does not rattle you, it interests you. You see opportunity.

  • You enjoy problem-solving and have a natural curiosity that drives you to find creative solutions.

  • You are looking for a role that comes with key responsibility beyond the typical SDR scope.

  • You take ownership, ask for help when you are stuck, act on feedback, and pass on what you learn to the people who join after you.

Bonus points

  • You have been a founding or first SDR in a new market, or helped stand up a new territory.

  • You know the ERP domain, or have sold Finance, Procurement, or industrial software and are familiar with P2P/O2C processes.

  • You are familiar with HubSpot as a CRM and Clay.

  • You speak another European language.

 

What you'll get

  • London Office. This role is based in our London office, You will spend regular time with your DACH peers in our HQ in Zurich and are invited over for onboarding.

  • Onboarding built for a founding rep. There is onboarding material that trains you on our product, you get a buddy from the DACH SDR team and direct support from the VP Business Development.

  • High earning potential. Uncapped commission and potential for a 6-figure package.

  • Equal OTEs. As we share the same incentives, you'll be comped as the Account Executives.

  • Opportunities to grow. You're controlling your personal development and career trajectory in a rapidly growing, internationally expanding startup.

  • Exceptional colleagues. You'll be growing alongside individuals from exceptional academic backgrounds and careers.

 

Learn more about blp and our values at blp.digital/company/careers.

title: BDR Manager
description:
About Kernel

Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?

Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.

Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.

Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent KERN ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Checkout already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them.

We have raised $14M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 5x YoY.

Your Role

As Marketing Lead, you turn marketing into a reliable source of qualified pipeline across the UK, Luxembourg and Germany. You report to the Co-Founder and own the marketing plan, budget and team.

Our buyers are GPs, CFOs, COOs and fund operations teams at VC and PE managers. The founders set the company narrative; you build the engine that carries it to market.

Top priorities

Own marketing’s pipeline contribution

  • Set marketing’s pipeline target by market with the CEO and own the result: qualified pipeline in euros across the UK, Luxembourg and Germany.

Build the engine across three vectors

You orchestrate; you run the writer.

  • Growth and online: with our Growth Marketing Manager and our sales ops and data team, the digital channels, pooled audiences and the HubSpot attribution and MQL→SQL layer that turn attention into qualified pipeline.

Own positioning and product marketing, with Product

  • Positioning and messaging by tier, release go-to-market, and sales enablement (one-pagers, battlecards, demo narratives). Product owns the roadmap and release notes; you own how the market hears about them.

  • Become an expert in our product: sit with client onboarding and the fund specialists until you can demo and explain the platform yourself.

Work hand in hand with sales

  • Run the marketing surround on named target accounts in HubSpot and hand engagement signals on to the sales team, so their next touch lands warm. Sellers own their accounts; marketing never emails a prospect one-to-one.

  • Bring market insight back to the commercial team: what our buyers read, discuss and care about, in a weekly market brief you own.

Build the function

You will lead the Production Inference team — the group responsible for the systems that serve DeepL's language AI models reliably and efficiently at scale. The team owns the full model serving stack — from GPU-resident inference runtimes and deployment infrastructure through to the developer platform that enables every other research team to bring their models to production. We operate within the Research organisation, with close ties to DeepL's infrastructure and platform functions, and our architectural decisions affect every product DeepL ships. Your responsibilities

As Engineering Manager for the Production Inference team, you will own both people leadership and technical direction for a team of research scientists and ML engineers working on performance-critical model serving systems. While this is not a hands-on coding role, you will be deeply involved in technical reviews, architecture decisions, and research direction for the inference stack.

 

You will:

  • Lead and develop a high-performing team of research scientists and ML engineers, building strong development plans, fostering a candid and non-retaliatory feedback culture, and maintaining high standards of technical rigour and delivery.

  • Own the team's research and development roadmap for production inference systems, in close collaboration with senior ICs and cross-functional stakeholders, balancing near-term reliability commitments with longer-horizon research bets on inference efficiency and architecture.

  • Act as the primary technical interface between the Production Inference team and adjacent functions — including foundational models research, voice research, applied research, infrastructure, and product — ensuring research output is well-scoped, well-communicated, and delivered without creating downstream bottlenecks.

  • Drive the reliability, efficiency, and cost performance of DeepL's model serving stack, including strategic decisions around serving infrastructure evolution (load balancing, autoscaling, runtime selection, and hardware utilisation).

  • Operate with a high degree of autonomy, defining the team's direction and pushing for results in an environment where requirements from product or commercial stakeholders can be ambiguous or evolving.

  • Play an active role in identifying, assessing, and recruiting research and engineering talent as the team continues to develop.

 

Qualities we look for

  • You have proven experience leading a team of researchers or ML engineers, with a track record of developing talent, maintaining delivery rigour, and holding the balance between research quality and production reliability.

  • You have a strong background Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, or a comparable quantitative discipline, or possess a strong ML/systems background with equivalent research depth.

  • You have a strong foundation in production ML systems, inference optimisation, or model serving at scale — direct experience with LLM inference, speculative decoding, quantisation, or serving infrastructure is a meaningful differentiator.

  • You are comfortable operating across the full model lifecycle — from training handoff through to production deployment, monitoring, and efficiency improvement — and understand infrastructure and compute constraints without needing to own them directly.

  • You have excellent communication skills and the ability to translate complex technical direction into clear goals for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • You are solution-oriented and decisive, able to define direction and drive outcomes without waiting for direction from above.

With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.

  • Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.

  • Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.

  • 30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.

  • Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

 

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

title: Director of Product Marketing
Alliance & Delivery Manager, Pharma Partnerships
description:
About Orakl Oncology

At Orakl Oncology, we combine patient-derived tumor models, experimental drug screening and computational modelling to improve oncology drug development. Our research brings together functional treatment-response measurements, molecular profiles and clinical information where available, creating opportunities to investigate how experimental responses translate into patient outcomes. Our platforms are designed to help anticipate clinical trial outcomes, evaluate therapies and identify new therapeutic opportunities.

Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients who need them and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalised. We collaborate with top hospitals, research institutes, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by leading investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology.

About the Role

We are looking for an Alliance & Delivery Manager to own Orakl's pharma partnerships after signature: the partner relationship, the delivery of each research program, and the growth of each account.

Orakl runs research programs for pharmaceutical companies on its virtual patient cohorts, combining compound screening, multi-omics and O-Predict analyses on the partner's assets. Several programs run in parallel on the same wet-lab and dry-lab teams, and the portfolio is growing. Delivery quality directly drives renewals and follow-on contracts.

This is a high-ownership, partner-facing role. You are the partner's main contact, you are accountable for delivery across our wet-lab and dry-lab teams, and you grow existing accounts. You will also scale our delivery processes and tooling: project tracking, capacity planning and partner reporting, automated wherever possible.

You will work closely with the Scientific Program & Operations Lead, Business Development, the Wet Lab, Data Science and Computational Biology leads, and Product. As the ideal candidate, you have already delivered complex scientific programs for pharma clients, and you are an expert at establishing partner trust.

What You'll Do

Own partner relationships: act as the main point of contact for each pharma partner from kick-off to final delivery. Map decision-makers, priorities and expectations for their asset, run the steering committees, attend key international conferences a few times per year and present results alongside our scientific teams.

Lead program delivery: translate each signed contract into an executable plan for the Wet Lab and Dry Lab teams, with owners, milestones and deliverables. Own the timeline, coordinate the experimental and computational work, and ensure every deliverable passes internal QC and review before it reaches the partner.

Manage capacity across programs: plan capacity with the Wet Lab and Dry Lab leads, arbitrate conflicts between programs and protect committed timelines. Centralise requests on delivery teams coming from partners and Business Development.

Manage risk and change: anticipate delivery risks, including results that change the plan, and escalate to the Scientific Program & Operations Lead with a recommendation. Agree and document scope and timeline changes with partners.

Scale delivery processes and tooling: scale our project management system in Asana, from program templates and timelines to portfolio and capacity views. Automate reporting and follow-up, deploy AI tools where they remove manual work, and document how we run programs.

Grow existing accounts: identify, qualify and convert follow-on opportunities within existing partnerships. Work with Business Development on scoping, proposals and pricing, and provide a feasibility assessment before anything is committed.

Plan scientific and BD materials: schedule conference and BD material cycles as part of the delivery plan, and coordinate partner approvals for any communication based on partnered programs.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 4+ years in project management, alliance and/or account management, or partner delivery in biotech, pharma, a CRO or a techbio.

  • Master's degree in a scientific or engineering field. A PhD is a strong plus.

  • Demonstrated delivery of complex scientific programs: you have led multidisciplinary projects from plan to final deliverable, including when results reshaped the plan.

  • Pharma-facing experience: you have managed pharma stakeholders through steering committees, negative results and scope negotiations.

  • Commercial track record: you have identified and converted follow-on opportunities within existing accounts.

  • Hands-on systems building: you have designed project management systems and automated recurring workflows.

  • Working knowledge of oncology or molecular biology, sufficient to lead scientific discussions with our teams and partners.

  • Fluent in English

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in precision oncology or at a pharma-facing CRO.

  • Familiarity with patient-derived tumor models, omics or drug screening.

  • Scripting (Python) or experience deploying automation and AI tools.

  • Experience working with SOWs and contracts.

  • Professional French.

Who You Are

  • An owner: you take responsibility for outcomes across teams you do not manage, and you make explicit trade-offs when programs compete.

  • Scientifically fluent: you understand what a result means for the partner's asset before you plan around it.

  • Steady under pressure: you replan quickly if the data changes, and you deliver difficult news to partners clearly and early.

  • A builder: you treat every recurring manual task as something to standardise or automate.

  • Commercially minded: you recognise when a partner's needs extend beyond the signed scope and turn it into a proposal.

Why Join Orakl

  • Own a portfolio of pharma partnerships. Represent Orakl from signature to final delivery, with direct access to partner decision-makers.

  • Work on distinctive science. Deliver programs built on virtual patients cohorts, functional drug screening & multi-omics.

  • Build the delivery model. Design how Orakl runs partnered programs as the portfolio scales.

  • Work across disciplines every day. Alongside the biologists, data scientists and computational biologists who generate the results.

  • Help shape the team. Define the delivery capabilities and future team needs as the partnership portfolio grows.

Interview Process

  1. Hiring Manager Call: align on motivation, role scope and expectations.

  2. Technical Deep Dive: discuss a pharma program you delivered: the plan, the problems, how you managed the partner and the outcome.

  3. Delivery Case: using an anonymised, representative scenario, build a plan, triage issues and prepare a steering committee. Present it to the team.

  4. Reference Call: speak with one or two people who have seen you manage partners and deliver programs.

  5. Founder Interview: discuss Orakl's partnership strategy and mutual ambitions.

description:
About H:
H exists to push the boundaries of superintelligence with agentic AI. By automating complex, multi-step tasks typically performed by humans, AI agents will help unlock full human potential.
H is hiring the world’s best AI talent, seeking those who are dedicated as much to building safely and responsibly as to advancing disruptive agentic capabilities. We promote a mindset of openness, learning, and collaboration, where everyone has something to contribute.

About the Team:
You’ll work alongside our CEO and make sure H follows through on every decision, relationship and commitment. This is a hands-on operator role. You’ll prepare our CEO for what’s coming, close the loop on what has happened, and run the projects that sit between teams. You’ll work closely with the CEO’s Executive Assistant.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Our CEO’s agenda: Prepare key meetings with context, bios, goals and talking points. Capture decisions and actions, and chase them until they’re done.

  • Relationships: Keep the CEO’s relationship tracker (investors, customers, partners, press) accurate. Every email, LinkedIn message and invitation gets a timely response, a named owner, or a polite decline.

  • Trips and events: Plan high-value schedules for trips and conferences, for example 6 to 8 qualified meetings in a city. Work with GTM leads to source the meetings and with the EA to get them into the CEO’s diary.

  • Memos and materials: Draft memos, briefs, all-hands slides and presentations that need little editing.

  • Visibility across teams: Gather updates from across the company, track how key priorities are progressing, and raise risks early with a proposed fix.

  • Ad hoc projects: Take on strategic projects as they come up and see them through to the end.

Requirements:

  • Technical Skills:

    • Around 2 to 5 years in strategy consulting, startup operations, VC, or a founder or associate role. We care more about what you’ve delivered than about the exact number of years.

    • Excellent written and spoken English and French.

    • Experience managing a high volume of competing priorities for a senior stakeholder.

    • Confident with modern tools (Notion, Google Workspace, CRMs, AI assistants).

  • Soft Skills:

    • You follow through on every yes and are selective about what you commit to.

    • You own the chase. “They didn’t get back to me” is never where it ends.

    • You come to meetings prepared, with data and updates in hand.

    • You bring a solution to every problem or blocker.

    • You get the right people involved at the right time, and your communication style is anchored in influencing without authority.

    • You know when to push back and when to knuckle down and deliver.

    • You’re calm, disciplined and organised, including when volume is high.

    • You handle confidential information with discretion.

  • Bonus Skills:

    • Experience building simple automations. You use AI and automation to remove manual work instead of adding to it.

What Success Looks Like After 90 Days:

  • No relationship falls through the cracks.

  • Every key meeting is prepped, followed up and tracked.

  • Our CEO spends no time on logistics or chasing people.

Location:

  • Paris or London.

  • This role is hybrid, and you are expected to be in the office 3 days a week on average.

  • Regular travel to the US and across Europe.

What We Offer:

  • Join the exciting journey of shaping the future of AI, and be part of the early days of one of the hottest AI startups.

  • Collaborate with a fun, dynamic, and multicultural team, working alongside world-class AI talent in a highly collaborative environment.

  • Enjoy a competitive salary.

  • Unlock opportunities for professional growth, continuous learning, and career development.

If you want to change the status quo in AI, join us.

title: Securities Operations Intern (f/m/d)
description:
About Us:

At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money. Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business.

We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.

 

About the role:

In 2027, Upvest is launching the PEA (Plan d'Épargne en Actions) on the French market with several leading fintechs. Within the Settlements & Transfers team, you will work across the full post-trade chain of securities account and PEA transfers: from instruction processing to settlement at Euroclear France, including relations with account keepers, custodians and issuers.

This internship offers direct exposure to French and European post-trade operations during a product launch, with real responsibilities from your first weeks.

What you’ll do:

  • Incoming and outgoing transfers: Handle securities account (CTO) and PEA transfers with banks and brokers in France and across Europe, from receipt of the request to settlement of securities and cash.

  • Counterparty and client relations: Ensure smooth communication with counterparties (banks, brokers, custodians) and our clients, and drive the follow-up of requests and reminders.

  • Controls and reconciliation: Check securities and cash positions, reconcile movements with our custodian and analyse breaks.

  • Fails and exception management: Investigate unsettled or rejected instructions, identify the root cause and coordinate resolution with counterparties and internal teams.

  • PEA tax continuity: Review and record PEA tax statements (bordereaux d'information) to ensure the plan's tax history is fully preserved.

  • Registered shares: Process operations on French registered shares (conversions, de/registrations).

  • Reporting and continuous improvement: actively monitor SLAs and KPIs, write operating procedures and identify automation opportunities.

What you bring:

  • Education: Master's degree (M1 or M2) in Finance, Banking, Economics or Law from a business school, engineering school or university; gap-year students and recent Master's graduates able to sign an internship agreement are welcome.

  • Languages: You have native-level or bilingual proficiency in French (C2) and are comfortable working in English.

  • Experience: A first experience in banking, back office, middle office or securities operations is a strong plus, as is knowledge of the PEA, post-trade or Euroclear France.

  • Analytical mindset: Rigour, attention to detail and a taste for solving complex problems.

  • Tools: You're confident with spreadsheets ; knowledge SQL/Python is a plus.

How we Upvest in you:

  • Impact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits.

  • Team celebrations: Participate in company-wide events, such as UpFest, dinners, offsites and our Holiday party, to connect with colleagues and celebrate our achievements.

  • Inclusion: We’re committed to a culture where everyone belongs and thrives. Our Employee Resources Groups foster inclusion and connection, like Upfem Black at Upvest, Up&Out, and UpVergent.

Our Values:

  • Make it easy for others. We simplify the complex and act with the best intentions

  • Own the outcome. We are proactive, fast and confident to get the job done, valuing progress over perfection.

  • Rise to the challenge. We aim high and push the boundaries. We stay curious, learn and celebrate our wins together.

  • Tell the story. We start with the Why to align on purpose. We are transparent and share knowledge to empower and inspire others.

Upvest is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Stagiaire Opérations Titres (f/h/d)
description:
À propos de nous

Chez Upvest, notre mission est de rendre l’investissement aussi simple que dépenser de l’argent. Upvest permet aux entreprises de proposer une large gamme de produits d’investissement et la meilleure expérience en matière d’investissement sur les marchés de capitaux et d’épargne retraite. Notre Investment API s’intègre facilement, pour que les fintechs et les institutions financières puissent se concentrer pleinement sur leur cœur de métier.

Nous travaillons avec les principales fintechs et institutions financières européennes, comme DKB, Revolut, N26 et Raisin. Fondée en 2017 par Martin Kassing, Upvest réunit aujourd’hui plus de 270 professionnels de plus de 70 nationalités. Upvest a levé 280 M€ auprès d’investisseurs de premier plan, dont BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital et Motive. Notre dernier tour de table de 105 M€, en mars 2026 et mené par Sapphire et Tencent, accélère notre croissance et nous permet d’offrir une expérience d’investissement haut de gamme.

Le poste

En 2027, Upvest lance le Plan d’Épargne en Actions (PEA) sur le marché français avec plusieurs fintechs de premier plan. Au sein de l’équipe Settlements & Transfers, vous intervenez sur l’ensemble de la chaîne post-marché des transferts de comptes-titres et de PEA : du traitement des instructions au dénouement chez Euroclear France, en passant par les relations avec les teneurs de compte, les dépositaires et les émetteurs.

Ce stage vous offre une exposition directe au post-marché français et européen dans une phase de lancement, avec de réelles responsabilités dès les premières semaines.

Vos missions

  • Transferts entrants et sortants : Prendre en charge les transferts de comptes-titres (CTO) et de PEA avec les banques et courtiers en France et en Europe, de la réception de la demande jusqu’au dénouement des titres et des espèces.

  • Relations contreparties et clients : Assurer une communication fluide avec les contreparties (banques, courtiers, dépositaires) et nos clients, et piloter le suivi des demandes et des relances.

  • Contrôles et réconciliations : Vérifier les positions titres et espèces, rapprocher les mouvements avec notre dépositaire et analyser les écarts.

  • Gestion des suspens et des anomalies : Analyser les instructions non dénouées ou rejetées, en identifier l’origine et coordonner leur résolution avec les contreparties et les équipes internes.

  • Fiscalité du PEA : Contrôler et intégrer les bordereaux d’information (BI) afin de garantir la continuité de l’historique fiscal du plan.

  • Titres au nominatif : Traiter les opérations sur titres nominatifs (conversions, inscriptions, radiations).

  • Reporting et amélioration continue : Suivre activement les SLA et les KPI, rédiger les procédures et identifier des pistes d’automatisation.

Votre profil

  • Formation : Master 1 ou 2 en finance, banque, économie ou droit (école de commerce, d’ingénieurs ou université), en année de césure ou jeune diplômé(e) d’un Master, avec possibilité de signer une convention de stage. Pour les M1 : votre établissement doit permettre un stage de 6 mois à temps plein (semestre intégré ou dispense de cours).

  • Langues : Français langue maternelle (indispensable) et anglais courant.

  • Expérience : Une première expérience en banque, back-office, middle-office ou opérations titres est un réel atout, tout comme une connaissance du PEA, du post-marché ou d’Euroclear France.

  • Motivation : Un véritable intérêt pour les marchés de capitaux et les opérations post-marché.

  • Esprit d’analyse : Rigueur, sens du détail et goût pour la résolution de problèmes complexes.

  • Outils : Bonne maîtrise d’Excel / Google Sheets ; la connaissance de SQL/Python est un plus.


Pourquoi nous rejoindre

  • Un travail à fort impact : Nous construisons l’infrastructure qui portera l’avenir de l’investissement en Europe. C’est complexe, ambitieux et porteur de sens. Vous travaillerez avec des technologies modernes et créerez quelque chose de totalement nouveau, sans système hérité et sans limites.

  • Moments d’équipe : Participez aux événements d’entreprise comme UpFest, les dîners, les offsites et la fête de fin d’année, pour échanger avec vos collègues et célébrer nos réussites.

  • Inclusion : Nous nous engageons pour une culture où chacun a sa place et s’épanouit. Nos groupes de ressources pour les employés favorisent l’inclusion et les liens, comme Upfem Black at Upvest, Up&Out et UpVergent.


Nos valeurs

  • Make it easy for others. Nous simplifions le complexe et agissons avec les meilleures intentions.

  • Own the outcome. Nous sommes proactifs, rapides et confiants pour faire avancer les choses : le progrès avant la perfection.

  • Rise to the challenge. Nous visons haut et repoussons les limites. Nous restons curieux, apprenons et célébrons nos réussites ensemble.

  • Tell the story. Nous commençons par le « pourquoi ». Nous sommes transparents et partageons nos connaissances pour inspirer les autres.

Upvest garantit l’égalité des chances. Nous célébrons la diversité et nous nous engageons à créer un environnement inclusif pour tous. À compétences égales, tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.

title: Commercial BtoB
description:
Qui sommes-nous ?

Mon Courtier Énergie est un acteur majeur du courtage en énergie en France.

Nous accompagnons les professionnels (TPE, PME, collectivités, industriels…) dans la maîtrise et l’optimisation de leurs dépenses énergétiques, à travers un service complet : comparaison d’offres, accompagnement fournisseur, consulting, solutions vertes, bornes électriques et rénovations énergétiques.

Créé en France et aujourd’hui fort de plus de 200 collaborateurs répartis dans 34 agences en France et à l’étranger, notre groupe affiche une croissance constante et des ambitions fortes.

Votre rôle

Au sein de l’agence de Villeneuve d'Ascq, vous intégrerez une équipe soudée et dynamique !

Votre mission : créer et développer un portefeuille client en BtoB et accompagner vos interlocuteurs dans le choix de solutions énergétiques adaptées à leurs besoins.

Vos principales responsabilités

  • Prospecter de nouveaux clients professionnels (TPE, PME, industries…) sur votre zone dédiée.
  • Gérer l’intégralité du cycle de vente, de la première prise de contact à la signature du contrat.
  • Adopter une démarche de conseil et construire une relation durable et de confiance avec vos clients.
  • Suivre votre activité via les outils CRM et reporting mis à disposition.

Votre profil

  • Vous justifiez d’une première expérience commerciale réussie, idéalement en BtoB ou dans l’énergie.
  • Goût prononcé pour la prospection, le contact client et la négociation.
  • Autonome, persévérant(e) et orienté(e) résultats.
  • Vous appréciez le travail en équipe et partagez des valeurs de solidarité et de performance.

Ce que nous offrons

  • Fixe 24000 € + primes déplafonnées (moyenne an 1 : 35K€, an 2 : 55K€)
  • Avantages (tickets resto, mutuelle, transports, véhicule de service).

Une organisation innovante pour allier performance et bien-être

  • Un poste en CDI
  • Du mardi au vendredi et de 9h à 18h
  • Une organisation pensée pour votre efficacité : moins de jours, mais une productivité optimisée et un meilleur équilibre vie pro/vie perso.
  • Formation complète et continue, assurée dès votre arrivée
  • Véritable ambiance d’équipe, dans des locaux modernes et conviviaux à Villeneuve d'Ascq
  • Perspectives d’évolution vers des postes de management ou d’expertise

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Parce que chez Mon Courtier Énergie, c’est vous qui faites la différence !

🌴 Notre culture : détendue, directe et orientée résultats

Chez PropertyOS, on apprécie les échanges simples, les idées utiles et les personnes qui prennent des initiatives.

Nature : partenariat indépendant d’apport d’affaires, sans contrat de travail.
Lieu : à distance, depuis la France.
Organisation : libre, sans exclusivité.
Démarrage : à convenir ensemble.

Vous devez disposer d’une activité indépendante déclarée et d’un SIRET pour exercer depuis la France. La micro-entreprise est une possibilité.

Our Mission:

Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.

Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.

Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact.   • Fluent French and English

  • Credible with C-suite buyers, especially Finance, Procurement and Legal

Where this goes

You'll build and lead Omnea's France business. As the market grows, so do your team and your remit. We run as a meritocracy, and we've signed the Future Founder Promise, so if you want to start your own company one day, we'll back that too.

How you'll work

This role is remote while we build our presence in France.

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. title: Senior Software/AI Engineer
description:
EggAI · Full-time · Remote (EU & UK)

The Role

A very strong senior software engineer with deep, hands-on experience building and operating production systems. We hire for engineering strength first: people who write good software, reason about failure, and own what they ship.

You will work in a team of 2 to 6 engineers on a client project. Clients come to us because we work at the forefront of AI in the enterprise; you help implement our AI strategy.

AI experience is required. Much of our work involves LLM-powered and agentic systems, and while you may not be working directly on LLMs, you will be working on LLM based systems.

What You'll Do

  • Build and operate the production systems at the centre of the engagement, end to end — you own what you ship, including after it's reached production

  • Lead architecture discussions for your part of the system, with the support of the wider team

  • Take ownership: pick up the ambiguous problem, chase down the answer, and say so when something is going wrong

  • Work directly with the client's engineers and with our project manager / product owner

  • Work in a "normal" team rhythm — daily standups, planning, retrospectives, code and design review

What We're Looking For

  • 10+ years designing, building and maintaining production systems that real users depend on — clean testable code, sound API and data modelling, and the judgement to know which abstractions are worth it

  • Production AI experience: You have built and operated GenAI systens in production with real users

  • Has owned code in production — deployment, monitoring, on-call or equivalent — and can debug hard problems in live systems: concurrency, performance, data correctness

  • Distributed systems fundamentals: services, queues, retries, idempotency, failure modes, and integrating third-party APIs that are not reliable

  • Databases: schema design, query performance, migrations

  • Operational rigour: meaningful automated testing, useful instrumentation, CI/CD and shipping incrementally

  • Client-facing ability: has delivered against real business requirements and can hold a technical conversation with non-engineers

  • Languages: Python (primary), TypeScript/JavaScript. Strong engineers coming from Go, Java, C#, Rust or similar who are willing to work in Python are in scope

  • Infrastructure: cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure), containerisation

Desired qualities

  • Depth — you can explain the systems you built and the trade-offs you chose

  • Balances speed of iteration with production reliability

  • Clear communicator, in writing as well as in conversation

  • Learns new domains quickly and deliberately

Interview Process

  1. Introductory call - 30 minutes

  2. Behavioural/Management interview - 60 minutes

  3. Technical interview (choice of walking through own code, live coding, or take home exercise) - 60 minutes

title: AI Engineering Lead
description:
EggAI · Full-time · Remote (EU only)

The Role

You will lead a small, highly-skilled remote team of engineers designing and shipping production-grade agentic AI systems. Working directly with enterprise clients, you will validate where AI can create value, redesign business processes, and own the resulting system from early experiments through adoption and measurable results.

Across these environments, you will learn from recurring production failure modes and have the latitude to choose the models, tools, and architecture to solve the business problem.

Alongside client delivery, you will turn successful approaches into shared assets that strengthen future engagements. Those contributions will shape EggAI's engineering culture and give you broad influence over how we work.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will write production code, set technical direction, develop engineers through example, review, feedback, and coaching, and guide senior client stakeholders through difficult decisions.

This is a remote position. We only accept candidates located in the EU.

What You'll Own

Act as a trusted technical counterpart to client teams throughout the engagement, helping them make sound decisions and create lasting capability as you:

  • Discover: Validate business opportunities against AI capabilities and constraints, and identify new opportunities enabled by the technology.

  • Design: Own solution design and system architecture across agents, tools, data, evaluations, controls, human oversight, and deterministic boundaries.

  • Build: Personally implement the system's critical agents, integrations, evaluation infrastructure, permissions, observability, controls, and feedback loops.

  • Deliver: Lead the team and client from implementation through adoption, owning engineering quality and production readiness while establishing a clear delivery rhythm and engineering accountability across the project team.

  • Compound: Package successful work as tools, datasets, evaluations, patterns, and engineering methods.

What We're Looking For

  • A sustained record of exceptional technical leadership that generated real business impact, including experience leading small engineering teams.

  • Experience designing, shipping, and operating production-grade AI systems, with practical judgment across architecture, context, tools, evaluation, observability, production controls, reliability, and cost.

  • A demonstrated ability to keep pace with advances in AI, test what matters, and change working methods when new capabilities prove substantive, evidenced by advanced use of agentic AI in day-to-day work.

  • Repeated ownership of difficult stakeholder environments and the judgment to connect technical decisions to business value, user needs, risk, and organizational change.

  • Excellent communication skills across engineering, product, and business stakeholders.

  • Strong coding skills and the ability to write and review production-grade code in languages such as Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, or similar.

  • A strong engineering foundation and the first-principles judgment to understand what established practices protect and how those protections should be implemented in AI-native systems.

  • Strong statistical and experimental judgment, including the ability to create the instrumentation, annotation, review, and feedback loops needed to learn from uncertain AI behaviour and improve systems over time.

Additional strengths

  • Experience operating AI systems in security-sensitive or regulated environments.

  • Experience creating AI tooling, evaluation infrastructure, data assets, or engineering platforms that serve multiple projects.

  • A track record of hiring, onboarding, and developing engineering talent.

  • Meaningful open-source work, public technical contributions, or active participation in the AI-engineering community
